answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake and keep a steady pulse of verified useful work, checked by independent peers, before it can earn or vote. A whisper of activity is not enough: reputation must build slowly and fade without real contribution, so spawning fake identities means funding every stake and sustaining every history, like crossing a dune grain by grain. An attacker then pays a rising per-identity cost that an honest agent pays only once.
